evidence: The supplied workbook quality row 16 requires inputs and the ask without a finished deliverable. The frozen skill procedure at references/quality-checks.md:70-71 requires an empty app, no task starter/schema/routes/UI, and no exposed criterion text. task/environment/Dockerfile:14-24 copies only instructions/ and assets/, creates /app and commits only .gitkeep; it neither copies solution/ nor tests/. The full environment tree contains exactly that Dockerfile, two Markdown instruction files and one JSON seed; there are no symlinks or hidden task payloads. Read all shipped seed data and notes: they contain business inputs, constants, records and requirements, not executable application code or a database schema. task/environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:53-55 leaves routes, field names, IDs and page structure open; :430-435 explicitly prescribes no HTTP route or request schema; instruction.md:9 leaves other routes/files to the builder. The ordinary required GET /api/health and server entry are runtime contract, not a route-list solution. A scripted scan of both notes against all five judge TOMLs found no criterion-ID/full-description overlap and no grader-machinery terms. Actual isolated probe of the already built image sha256:ff70849eebd9fcd2f91602ceb3518db6f6a1984d0e2f29f8a45019f4c24bc359 (docker run --rm --network none --read-only --entrypoint node) exited 0. /app contained only .git and .gitkeep; git history/tree contained only .gitkeep; /solution, /tests, /app/server.js, /app/app.db and /app/schema.sql were absent. All three exposed input files matched the frozen SHA256 values byte for byte. Raw output, command and hashes are in per-row-review/evidence/16/image-boundary.json (b80fe0e4732c877cf0dd15e3693ad3926faa214ef5e11030be63f4ccebe80555). The current raw-evidence-index.json SHA256 is 8592824b072a0ee5308bd4a7bf5a364d854cf475b658778b9e36b9b9f12a244d; all 129 indexed artifact hashes matched. The indexed build-agent.log also matches its claimed hash and reports this exact image ID. This establishes the environment exposure claim only; it makes no configured judge, Oracle, workload or model-score claim.
counterexample: Adversarial attempt: submit a nominal server by copying a prebuilt /solution/app/server.js, restoring an earlier implementation from /app/.git, or serving a shipped UI/SQLite database as if authored. The inspected image has no such solution path, app source, database or historical Git payload, so this shortcut is unavailable. Conforming alternative: independently implement the public rules with a different SQLite schema, route organization and UI, generating its own record IDs and beginning with empty operational records while using supplied users/employees/constants. instruction.md:9-11 and hireops_rules.md:53-55,91-95,430-435 explicitly allow these choices; absence of scaffolding does not force the golden design or cause this row to fail. No credible leakage counterexample found.
